concerns: One MAJOR defect confirmed: dashboard.js:1284 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null` but shadow.ts emits the field as `candidate_executor_used`. The executor column in the shadow variants strip will always display "—" instead of the actual executor value. Fix: change to `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`. All 565 tests pass. All other acceptance criteria in .autoforge-review.md are PASS.

findings.description: dashboard.js:1284 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null` but shadow.ts records the field as `candidate_executor_used` (lines 70, 93, 132, 141). The executor column in the shadow variants strip will always show "—" instead of the real executor value. Fix: `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`.

computeExecProgressInfo (dashboard.js:620) uses `task.iteration ?? 1` as a fallback. The first iteration is 0, not 1. In practice this cannot bite (all tasks with subtask_started events have task.iteration=0), but the fallback is semantically wrong and would silently display no active subtasks if task.iteration were ever missing on a modern task.

.autoforge-review.md describes a 'Latent bug: early return at dashboard.js:1131' but there is no early return there — the code only conditionally clears historyEl.innerHTML inside the `if (historyEl)` block; shadow strip rendering at line 1230 proceeds unconditionally regardless. The N-A conclusion is correct but the premise is inaccurate.
